data.body:
[P2] Preserve distinct emission identities when truncating timestamps

With `ON_CHANGE`, a RUNNING snapshot and the terminal snapshot can be built within the same millisecond. They now receive identical `emittedAt` values, but `SQSExporter` derives its FIFO deduplication ID solely from the execution ARN and `emittedAt`. If the asynchronous pump has already taken the RUNNING record, both snapshots are sent separately and SQS suppresses the terminal result as a duplicate. `DynamoDBExporter` similarly overwrites a history entry because its sort key is `emittedAt`. Keep the formatted timestamps, but add a stable per-record emission ID for FIFO deduplication and a history-key tie-breaker. Add regression coverage for two distinct snapshots built within one millisecond.
